plugin.name: Windows and doors
plugin.description: Parametric windows (sashes, glazing bars, sills) and doors (frame, leaf, handle) set into any wall with a click – the opening is cut through the wall. A schedule counts them and saves it as CSV.

panel.placeHint: Then click on a vertical wall face: the outline shows green where it fits. The window sits at the sill height above the bottom of the face, a door on it.
panel.sizeHint: Every setting can be changed here. A new size closes the old hole in the wall and cuts the new one, centred where the old one was.

list.title: Window and door schedule
list.empty: No windows or doors in the model yet.

tool.name: Set window or door
tool.status: Click on a vertical wall face to set the opening. Esc stops.

errors.notVertical: Windows and doors go into vertical wall faces only.
errors.tooBig: The opening does not fit on this face.
errors.cutFailed: The hole could not be cut here.
errors.noFace: No vertical wall face at this point.
errors.offWall: A window or door no longer lies fully on a wall face – it has no hole there.

script.opening: Sets a window or door into the wall face of a group (or the current context) that the point at lies on – the hole is cut through the wall. Sizes in metres; returns the new group.
